title: How We're Redefining the kg
summary: Veritasium explains why the kilogram is being redefined in terms of Planck's constant rather than a physical metal artifact. It visits NIST to show the Kibble balance and why measuring mass precisely is hard.
why: Praised as an excellent, accessible account of why the kilogram's definition changed, in redefinition threads.

quote.text: I found the Veritasium video to be a bit more interesting for the "why" aspect of this change
